edges.reason: Constructor assigns the owner state variable directly from the caller address, creating privileged control from msg.sender
The _newOwner parameter is stored in the newOwner state variable, staging a new privileged role
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner
acceptOwnership moves the owner role to the pending newOwner
transfernewun writes the restricted recipient address into newun
totalSupply is computed from the _totalSupply state variable
totalSupply subtracts the balance held at address(0) from the balances mapping
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the given token owner
The to parameter controls the recipient of the transfer
The tokens parameter controls the amount moved by transfer
The spender parameter is the allowance key in approve
The tokens parameter is the allowance value written in approve
The from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom
The to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom
The tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowance lookup
The spender parameter indexes the allowance lookup
The spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external callee in approveAndCall
The tokens parameter is the allowance value set in approveAndCall
The data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf
The _newun parameter is stored into the newun state variable
transfer reads newun to reject transfers to the restricted address
transferFrom reads and conditionally writes newun during execution
approve writes the allowed mapping
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping of the caller
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and recipient
transferFrom updates the balances mapping for from and to
The tokens parameter is the operand subtracted from the caller balance in transfer
The tokens parameter is the operand added to the recipient balance in transfer
The tokens parameter is the operand subtracted from balances and allowances in transferFrom
The tokens parameter is the operand added to the recipient balance in transferFrom
The local payable _owner is the destination of the full contract balance transfer
The onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender equalling owner
The onlyOwner modifier gates transfernewun on msg.sender equalling owner
The onlyOwner modifier gates clearCNDAO so only the owner can drain the balance
transfer executes SafeMath subtraction on the sender balance and allowance accounting
transfer executes SafeMath addition on the recipient balance
transferFrom executes SafeMath subtraction on balances and allowance
transferFrom executes SafeMath addition on the recipient balance
approveAndCall drives execution into an arbitrary external contract via receiveApproval
clearCNDAO performs a native value transfer to the caller before finishing
The external receiveApproval callee can call back into the token contract while approveAndCall has not completed
The recipient payable fallback can re-enter clearCNDAO or the token before state is finalized
